name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites with Carrots, Celery & Homemade Blue Cheese Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Place cauliflower in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat; drizzle with oil and toss once more. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (283 g) bag cauliflower florets
3 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cauliflower is just fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese to the bowl with the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the dressing. Transfer dressing to a serving bowl (if desired) and place on a serving platter; set aside.
Place hot sauce and butter in a small saucepan set over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the Buffalo sauce is warm and combined. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup hot sauce
1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower is fork-tender, remove from the oven and transfer to a clean large bowl. Drizzle with the Buffalo sauce, toss to coat, and return to the baking sheet.
Return cauliflower to the oven and continue to bake until charred in spots, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and trim carrots; quarter lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the platter with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the platter and set aside.
To serve, add cauliflower bites to the platter with the dressing, carrots, and celery. Enjoy!
